name: Glow text, ink stroke
what: A heavy word sits small and dim in the middle of a dark frame; a glowing ink stroke with a long tail loops around it, cuts through it twice and sweeps out to the right, and the word grows, thickens and lights up with a soft glow, then drifts a hair bigger to the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f7-f58 a tapered ink stroke flies a looping path around the word (in from the left f7, over the top f12, down to the lower left f16, through the word f19-f21, round the right side f27-f34, across the word f36, round the upper left f39-f43, down to the lower left f45-f52, out through the top of the word to the right f55-f58); f36-f88 the word grows to 1.33 times (an S-curve), gets bolder and brighter, and blooms in a soft glow (f50-f68); then it drifts a hair bigger to the end

tracks.name: ink stroke
tracks.what: a tapered stroke with a thick head loops around the word and out to the right
tracks.easing: a fast, looping path (measured head positions)

tracks.name: word grows
tracks.what: the word grows to 1.33 times and thickens as the stroke finishes

tracks.name: bloom
tracks.what: the word brightens and a soft glow spreads around it

tracks.name: drift
tracks.what: the word drifts a hair bigger
